title: The six tiles always show in the same order for every user
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  1. You are signed in as a user whose role has the Reports permission (for example Admin).
  2. You use a desktop browser window at least 1024 pixels wide (a maximised laptop or desktop window).
  3. A second staff member whose role is different but also has the Reports permission (e.g. a Service Manager), whose sign-in you have.
  4. You are in any location (workplace).

Setup

  • For 1: on the QA site's sign-in page, in the DEV MODE — QUICK LOGIN panel, click Admin (this signs you in as Admin ShopView). To use another role, check it has Reports: profile icon > Settings > Roles & Permissions > edit icon on the role > Reports is switched on.
  • For 3: check the role has Reports: profile icon > Settings > Roles & Permissions > edit icon on Service Manager > Reports is switched on. If you have no such staff member: profile icon > Settings > Staff > New Staff Member: First Name and Last Name (ZZAUTOTEST Second Viewer), an Email you can open, Role Service Manager, a Department, Location = your location > Save & Close; accept the invitation email and set a password, so you can sign in as them.
  • For 4: to change location, click your profile icon (your initials, top right, beside the current location name) > under Change Location: click the orange button showing the current location > pick the location from the list.
custom_steps:
1. Click "Dashboard" in the top navigation.
  2. Read the tile names in the top row from left to right.
  3. Read the tile names in the second row from left to right.
  4. Open a private browser window and sign in as the second user.
  5. Click "Dashboard" and read both rows again.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Top row, left to right: Revenue, Billing Efficiency, Technician Efficiency, Technician Utilization.
  • Second row, left to right: Sales by Customer, At Risk Customers.
  • The second user sees exactly the same six tiles in exactly the same places.
  • Both users see all six tiles (none is missing for either user).

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-490; story SV-9574 (Story 2, One Fixed Layout); Dashboard v1 PRD, Confluence 788430850 v42, read 7 Oct 2026, Story 2. Design canvas board 01_Opens_After (row 1).

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S2-R1: “The dashboard shows the four KPI tiles in a fixed top row, left to right: Revenue, Billing Efficiency, Technician Efficiency, Technician Utilization.”
  • S2-R2: “The dashboard shows the two count tiles below the KPI row, left to right: Sales by Customer, At Risk Customers.”
  • S2-R3: “The tile set and their order are the same for every user.”
  • S2-R4: “Every user who can open the dashboard sees all six tiles.”

Last checked against build v26.39.1-09be696 on 10/2/2026.
